notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
description:
Activate Patchwork Crawler using PuPu UFO's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Patchwork Crawler.
Repeat.
